items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 July 2026 4:08am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 24 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally increasing 5 in the east of the area this evening, before becoming 5 or 6 by the end of the night.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, gradually decreasing 2 to 4 by the evening, then veering northwest 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Occasional light rain and drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or drizzle at times.
